# Welcome to Zumtobel

# Zumtobel

## Innovative LED lighting solutions and lighting management

**Zumtobel, a leading international supplier of integral lighting solutions, enables people to
experience the interplay of light and architecture. As a leader in innovation, Zumtobel provides a
comprehensive range of high-quality LED luminaires and lighting management systems for professional
interior lighting in the areas of offices, education, presentation & retail, hotel & wellness,
health, art & culture as well as industry.**

**We provide everyone with the best light that we all enjoy so much **
For over 60 years, the Zumtobel brand has been synonymous with innovation, unique product and
service quality as well as superior design and sustainability. Zumtobel reconciles lighting quality
and energy efficiency and develops customised lighting solutions that provide measurable added
value. We cater individually for your requirements and users' needs, always keeping in mind the
result of supplying the best light for people and the environment.

## Innovative LED lighting solutions and lighting management

**Zumtobel, a leading international supplier of integral lighting solutions, enables people to
experience the interplay of light and architecture. As a leader in innovation, Zumtobel provides a
comprehensive range of high-quality LED luminaires and lighting management systems for professional
interior lighting in the areas of offices, education, presentation & retail, hotel & wellness,
health, art & culture as well as industry.**

**We provide everyone with the best light that we all enjoy so much **

service quality as well as superior design and sustainability. Zumtobel reconciles lighting quality
and energy efficiency and develops customised lighting solutions that provide measurable added
value. We cater individually for your requirements and users' needs, always keeping in mind the
result of supplying the best light for people and the environment.

motivation, and executive functions. Research suggests it can enhance decision-making, cognitive
speed, and attention.

concentration.

anxiety when combined with caffeine. It works synergistically with caffeine to create a state of
calm alertness, enhancing focus without jitters or anxiety.

### Electrolytes

Essential minerals including magnesium, potassium, and sodium to keep your system firing and your
endurance rock-steady.

### 300mg Natural Caffeine

combination can provide a clean, long-lasting energy boost without the crash associated with sugary
energy drinks.

## BRAINSTEAM™ Formula

### Alpha-GPC

Alpha-GPC is a choline compound that may help improve cognitive function, memory, creativity,
motivation, and executive functions. Research suggests it can enhance decision-making, cognitive
speed, and attention.

### L-Tyrosine

This amino acid plays a role in cognitive function, particularly in terms of focus and
concentration.

### L-Theanine

Found naturally in tea leaves, L-theanine is an amino acid that can promote relaxation and reduce
anxiety when combined with caffeine. It works synergistically with caffeine to create a state of
calm alertness, enhancing focus without jitters or anxiety.

### Electrolytes

Essential minerals including magnesium, potassium, and sodium to keep your system firing and your
endurance rock-steady.

### 300mg Natural Caffeine

Bulkhead Energy® uses natural caffeine (300mg per can) along with its nootropic blend. This
combination can provide a clean, long-lasting energy boost without the crash associated with sugary
energy drinks.

### Vitamins B3, B5, B6 & B12

These B vitamins are crucial for energy metabolism and cognitive function. They can further enhance
the cognitive and energy-boosting effects of the nootropic blend.

### Low Sodium

With only 65mg of sodium per can.

### Zero Sugar

Our cans have absolutely zero sugar.

### No Artificial Dyes

No artificial flavors or dyes.

Do you still use old-school light bulbs for night illumination and are afraid of electricity bills?
Knock it off! Make your residential building or business center shine bright like a Christmas tree
all night long by installing LED lights by Cisun Lighting. They can save you a bundle, reducing
energy consumption by over 85%! And no, you don’t have to fork out for them. As a reputable Chinese
LED lighting company, we provide façade, architectural, landscape, and other lighting solutions at
wholesale prices. 

Whether you want to bring efficient light to your shopping mall, hospital, or any other facility,
you can get it here. Our lights are available in curb appeal-boosting designs and extravagant yet

## 250LM/W Ultra-high Luminous Efficacy and Energy Saving

EXC has launched the Lighting Efficiency Leadership Program. Focusing on enhancing light efficiency,

[Hunter]

### Landscape Irrigation

Founded in 1981, Hunter Industries is a global manufacturer of products for the irrigation sector.
We offer a complete spectrum of water- and energy-efficient solutions for residential, commercial,
municipal, and agricultural applications. Our core mission will always remain the same: to deliver
valued products and services backed by unwavering customer support.

[Visit Site][38]
×
[Hunter]

### Golf

Hunter Industries has been on the forefront of golf course irrigation technology for more than three
decades. We build performance, reliability, and serviceability into every product. From
industry-leading rotor technology to intuitive irrigation control software, we take pride in
providing golf professionals the tools and support they need to conceptualize, create, and manage
world-class golf courses.

[Visit Site][39]
×
[FX Luminaire]

### Landscape & Architectural Lighting

FX Luminaire is an industry-leading manufacturer of landscape and architectural lighting solutions.
We focus on the advancement of LED technology and digital lighting control with smart home
integration and zoning, dimming, and color generation capabilities. We offer a full spectrum of
lighting fixtures and accessories to create elegant landscape lighting systems for commercial and
residential applications.

[Visit Site][40]
×
[Lumascape]

### Architectural & Facade Lighting

Lumascape transforms spaces with precision-engineered lighting solutions proven to perform. Since
1991, customers have relied on us to solve their toughest lighting challenges. Our global experts
combine sophisticated design, advanced technologies, quality materials, and rigorous testing to
manufacture comprehensive lighting systems that consistently exceed performance expectations.

[Visit Site][41]
×
[Hunter]

### Agricultural Irrigation

Hunter® Agricultural Irrigation is a leading designer and manufacturer of quality Senninger®
irrigation solutions for agricultural, horticultural, and industrial applications. Our global
experts in the field work with growers to help us develop products with real irrigation solutions
that use as little water and energy as possible to make the most of every drop. With over 6 decades
of experience in more than 90 countries worldwide, Senninger products are among the most trusted in
the irrigation industry.

[Visit Site][42]
×
[Dispensing Dynamics]

### Dispensing Technologies

As the original inventors of the away-from-home dispensing category, Dispensing Dynamics is proud to
continue a longstanding tradition of innovation with a range of dispensing systems that offer
unsurpassed reliability, design, performance, hygiene, and sustainability.

[Visit Site][43]
×
[Hunter]

### Custom Manufacturing

Hunter Custom Manufacturing is an integrated division of Hunter Industries. We provide customers
with state-of-the-art manufacturing solutions, tooling, quality control, and global logistics. We
are an ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 Rev D certified company. Our logistics team delivers finished goods
around the world.

[Visit Site][44]

### Who We Are

We provide top-quality solutions for a range of sectors worldwide

Hunter Industries is a global, family-owned company that provides innovative solutions of the
highest quality for the irrigation, outdoor lighting, dispensing technology, and custom
manufacturing industries. Our products are found everywhere from residential landscapes, commercial
complexes, and golf courses to stadiums, national landmarks, and municipal buildings worldwide.
Whether you’re from New York, Shanghai, Sydney, Paris, Moscow, Buenos Aires, or Cairo, you’ve
probably encountered a Hunter product somewhere along the way.

[Learn More][46]
[[About Hunter Industries]][47]
 
[Great Ideas][48]

### Innovation Is the Cornerstone of Hunter Industries

Welcome to the Great Ideas innovation website for Hunter Industries. We created this portal to
manage innovation development within Hunter Industries and invite you to join our efforts. From new
product development and product enhancements to sustainability and manufacturing, we want to hear
from you!

[Learn More][49]
[[Great Ideas]][50]
[[Social Responsibility]][51]
[Social Responsibility][52]

### Advancing Growth with Purpose

At Hunter, our core value of Social Responsibility guides us to make decisions today that create a
better tomorrow — especially as we grow. That’s why we’re committed to pursuing clear Sustainability
and Social Impact goals that help us balance the well-being of people, the health of the planet, and
the success of our business. We track our progress and share key outcomes each year through our
annual Impact Report.

[Learn More][53]
[Community][54]

### A Commitment to Our Communities

To demonstrate our core values of Family and Social Responsibility, Hunter Industries has a
longstanding history of supporting the communities where our employees live, work, and play. We’re
proud to meet our commitments with charitable contributions, volunteerism, product donations, and
outreach.

capability for innovation and Quality.

decades. We have supplied lighting fixtures in the domestic market for:

Our core values are:

## Industrial Lighting Manufacturer Since 1994

Established in 1994, Lightholm has grown into a trusted industrial lighting manufacturer in Europe.
We offer a wide range of innovative outdoor, industrial, and commercial lighting solutions, serving
streets, public spaces, sports facilities, and demanding environments like harbors and offshore
platforms. Our products combine durability, performance, and efficiency to meet the needs of
professionals across industries. With decades of experience, Lightholm delivers reliable,
solution-focused industrial lighting systems designed for both everyday use and extreme conditions,
ensuring safety, energy efficiency, and long-lasting performance.
[Learn more about Lightholm][17]

## Why to Choose Lightholm as Your Partner in Lighting

### TAILOR LIGHTING SOLUTIONS.

Lighting designed for your needs. As a leading industrial lighting manufacturer, we create custom
solutions that match each client’s specific requirements — efficiently and reliably.

### QUALITY IS OUR PASSION!

Excellence in every fixture. Every project benefits from our attention to detail and high-quality
materials, ensuring long-lasting, dependable performance.

### WE DELIVER FASTER THAN OTHERS!

Solutions delivered on time. We move faster than larger competitors, providing flexible, responsive
service that adapts to your schedule and project demands.

### WE REALLY CARE – YOU CAN TRUST US!

Lighting you can count on. We make complex installations effortless, prioritizing safety,
efficiency, and client satisfaction in every solution we provide.

### Upgrade the safety, value and beauty of your home

## Our Services

**Any size, any shape – We have a solution for every job**

We specialize in the installation of custom cellar doors, so no matter which cellar door style you
choose, you get safe and code-compliant access, weather-resistant performance and easy operation
with minimal maintenance.

– Fully-welded, heavy duty steel doors
– Slide bar locks for saftey and security
– Pre-fabricated steel stair and top door units available
– Bulkhead installation on metal stair units, concrete, stone, and all other foundation types.

## Additional Services
* Basement Door Installations
* Stairs (Wood/Concrete)
* Concrete Resurfacing
* Stair Tread Replacement

## [Enhance Your Home’s Curb Appeal With A Door Step Cover][3]

[July 16, 2026][4] / [Willard Schmidt][5]

When it comes to enhancing the exterior of your home, every detail matters. From the landscaping to
the front door, each element plays a crucial role in creating a welcoming and polished look. One
often overlooked aspect of the home’s exterior is the door step. However, with the addition of a
door step cover, you can not only protect your step but also add a stylish touch to your entryway.

A door step cover is a simple yet effective way to improve the functionality and aesthetics of your
home’s entrance. These covers are designed to fit over the existing step, providing protection
against wear and tear while also adding a decorative element to your doorstep. They come in a
variety of materials, styles, and colors, making it easy to find one that complements your home’s
exterior design.

One of the main benefits of a door step cover is that it helps to prevent damage to your step.
Constant exposure to the elements, such as rain, snow, and sunlight, can cause the step to
deteriorate over time. By installing a cover, you can shield your step from these elements,
prolonging its lifespan and reducing the need for repairs or replacements.

In addition to protecting your step, a door step cover can also improve the safety of your entrance.
Rain and snow can create slick conditions on the step, increasing the risk of slips and falls. A
cover provides a non-slip surface, giving you and your guests added traction when entering and
exiting your home. This added safety measure is especially important during inclement weather or
when the step is wet.

Furthermore, a door step cover can enhance the curb appeal of your home. The entrance is the first
thing guests see when approaching your home, so it’s important to make a good impression. A
well-designed cover can add a touch of style and sophistication to your doorstep, creating a more
inviting and attractive entryway. Whether you prefer a classic look or a more modern design, there
are door step covers available to suit your taste.

Another advantage of a door step cover is that it is easy to install and maintain. Most covers come
with simple installation instructions and require only basic tools to set up. Once in place, they
are easy to clean and can be maintained with regular sweeping or hosing down. This low-maintenance
feature makes door step covers a convenient and cost-effective solution for improving your home’s
exterior.

In addition to the practical benefits, a door step cover can also serve as a reflection of your
personal style. With a wide range of materials to choose from, such as rubber, metal, and wood, you
can customize the look of your cover to match the overall aesthetic of your home. Whether you prefer
a sleek and modern design or a more rustic and natural look, there is a door step cover to enhance
your entrance in just the way you envision.

Overall, a door step cover is a versatile and practical addition to any home’s exterior. Not only
does it protect your step and improve safety, but it also enhances the curb appeal of your home.
With so many options available, you can easily find a cover that suits your style and budget. So why
not give your doorstep a makeover today with a stylish and durable door step cover? [[door step
cover][6]]

In conclusion, a door step cover is a small investment that can make a big impact on the exterior of
your home. By adding protection, safety, and style to your doorstep, you can create a more welcoming
and aesthetically pleasing entryway. With the wide range of options available, you’re sure to find a
door step cover that enhances the curb appeal of your home while also reflecting your personal
taste. Don’t overlook this simple yet effective way to elevate the look of your home’s entrance.

### Metal Stamping

With 100+ presses, 1600+ open-tooled dies and expert in-house toolroom, Tripar’s capabilities
include progressive stamping, blanking, punching, bending, engraving, marking, embossing, rolling,
drawing and deep drawing. For high volumes and the lowest possible unit cost.

[ Learn more ][163]
[ [High precision CNC machine] ][164]

### CNC Fabrication

With Tripar’s vast CNC capabilities and experience, we manufacture a wide range of sheet metal
components through laser cutting, punching, bending, forming, spot welding, shearing, riveting,
clinch joining and assemblies too. For low volumes and fastest lead times.

[ Learn more ][165]

## Serving 350+ clients in US, Canada, Europe

[ ][166]

### [ Recessed Lighting ][167]

[Full line of stocked items][168]: IC Boxes, plaster frames, driver boxes, brackets, bar hangers,
and more.

### HVAC/R

Manufacture diffusers, grills, faceplates, louvers, housings, brackets, hinges, nameplates, etc.

### Warehouse Racking

Metal components like shims, brackets and support systems for new and existing warehouses.

### Consumer Goods

Central vacuums, extractor fans, storage cases, covers, trays, various components, etc.

### Aerospace

Many years producing engraving plates, heat shields, shielding cans and washers, and more.

## Design & Engineering

We offer design and engineering services for all your sheet metal components: Design for
Manufacturability (DFM), 3D modelling,  technical drawings, optimizations, and prototyping.

[ Learn more ][169]

## Knowledgeable Team

Tripar is a family business with 75+ years. We proudly manufacture everything under one roof with
our incredibly talented and knowledgeable team. 

[ Learn more ][170]

### The Tripar Advantage

### Optimize your production

Unlike most suppliers, we are not tied to a single fabrication method. Based on part complexity and
annual volumes, we will seamlessly migrate you from CNC fabrication, to hybrid manufacturing (combo
of CNC and stamping), to metal stamping. No need to worry if you're overpaying as quantities
increase.

# Sheet metal fabrication for businesses

We produce sheet metal parts and assemblies that OEMs rely on
* turnkey solutions
* 100 to millions of units
* small to medium size parts

### Metal Stamping

With 100+ presses, 1600+ open-tooled dies and expert in-house toolroom, Tripar’s capabilities
include progressive stamping, blanking, punching, bending, engraving, marking, embossing, rolling,
drawing and deep drawing. For high volumes and the lowest possible unit cost.

[ Learn more ][163]
[ [High precision CNC machine] ][164]

### CNC Fabrication

With Tripar’s vast CNC capabilities and experience, we manufacture a wide range of sheet metal
components through laser cutting, punching, bending, forming, spot welding, shearing, riveting,
clinch joining and assemblies too. For low volumes and fastest lead times.

[ Learn more ][165]

## Serving 350+ clients in US, Canada, Europe

Manufacture diffusers, grills, faceplates, louvers, housings, brackets, hinges, nameplates, etc.

### Warehouse Racking

Metal components like shims, brackets and support systems for new and existing warehouses.

### Consumer Goods

Central vacuums, extractor fans, storage cases, covers, trays, various components, etc.

### Aerospace

Many years producing engraving plates, heat shields, shielding cans and washers, and more.

## Design & Engineering

We offer design and engineering services for all your sheet metal components: Design for
Manufacturability (DFM), 3D modelling,  technical drawings, optimizations, and prototyping.

## Knowledgeable Team

Tripar is a family business with 75+ years. We proudly manufacture everything under one roof with
our incredibly talented and knowledgeable team.

annual volumes, we will seamlessly migrate you from CNC fabrication, to hybrid manufacturing (combo
of CNC and stamping), to metal stamping. No need to worry if you're overpaying as quantities
